content:
maria (PM): quick sync — need to lock prioritization for Q2 roadmap planning. three competing asks from customers + platform debt. can we decide sequencing and any staffing shifts?
akash (PM): +1. what are the three items?
linda (eng-manager): FYI we have two eng leads out for 2 wks starting next sprint. capacity is tight.
maria (PM): items: 1) Dedicated autoscaling (customer A, high SLA) 2) Observability retention increase for cost/latency analytics (platform) 3) Lightweight quantization recommendation engine (DevEx) — customer-driven but higher risk.
zoe (devex): quant recs would reduce unit cost for embeddings by ~20% on average for some workloads. small infra changes but requires model-validation & evals.
raj (infra): autoscaling needs infra work on burst nodes + routing fallbacks. medium infra effort, high cross-team testing.
tyler (ds): quant recommendations need model per-arch thresholds and an eval harness. we can reuse some of the Eval infra but will need 0.5 FTE for 6 weeks.
olivia (solutions): customer A is requesting autoscale by end of quarter or they will delay Dedicated purchase. it's material for ARR.
maria (PM): ok let's run a quick RICE-like check to inform tradeoffs. proposing rough scores (0-10) for Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort (lower better).
akash (PM): sounds good — keep it approximate.
linda (eng-manager): please call out cross-team deps explicitly — those often change sequencing.
maria (PM): here's my draft:
```
Autoscaling: Reach=8 Impact=9 Confidence=7 Effort=6
Observability retention: Reach=6 Impact=7 Confidence=8 Effort=3
Quant rec engine: Reach=5 Impact=6 Confidence=5 Effort=7
```
maria (PM): RICE-ish (Impact*Reach*Confidence / Effort) normalized-ish. numbers are illustrative.
zoe (devex): observability is low-effort, immediate wins for oncall and billing accuracy. we should prioritize that if goal is short-term risk reduction.
raj (infra): autoscaling high impact but heavy infra QA. we also need to coordinate with eng-runtime for fallback routing — potential 2-week integration window.
linda (eng-manager): given staff OOO, shipping autoscaling in the same sprint as other infra projects increases risk. sequencing suggestion: observability -> autoscaling -> quant.
tyler (ds): agree with sequencing but quant needs to be started early for data collection. can we allocate a small spike (2 weeks) concurrently?
olivia (solutions): if autoscaling slips customers delay contracting. that revenue risk is real. can we scope autoscale MVT smaller?
maria (PM): what if we do a scoped autoscale MVP (single-region, limited to Dedicated tier) to reduce effort and risk? then fall back to full rollout next quarter.
linda (eng-manager): scoped MVP reduces effort from 6 to 3 on my estimate, if we accept limited routing rules and manual burst pool sizing. needs product gating.
raj (infra): that could work. it reduces infra testing surface. still need one eng from runtime + one infra for the initial roll.
akash (PM): updated RICE with scoped autoscale effort lowered to 3:
```
Autoscaling (scoped MVP): Reach=7 Impact=8 Confidence=7 Effort=3 -> score ~ (7*8*7)/3 = 130.7
Observability: Reach=6 Impact=7 Confidence=8 Effort=3 -> score ~ (6*7*8)/3 = 112
Quant rec engine: Reach=5 Impact=6 Confidence=5 Effort=7 -> score ~ (5*6*5)/7 = 21.4
```
akash (PM): ranking by score => Autoscaling (scoped) > Observability > Quant.
zoe (devex): sounds reasonable. observability can be a small parallel stream — 1 FE + 1 BE for 3 weeks.
tyler (ds): I can commit 0.2 FTE to a 2-week spike for quant data collection if we keep it limited.
olivia (solutions): if autoscale MVP ships for Dedicated customers, that's a huge sales win. I support scoped approach.
linda (eng-manager): staffing ask: autoscale MVP -> 2 engineers for 3 weeks + 1 infra for integration testing. observability -> 1 BE + 1 FE for 3 weeks. quant spike -> 0.2 FTE from DS + 0.5 FTE from devex for 2 weeks.
maria (PM): decision proposal: 1) Prioritize Autoscaling (scoped MVP) as top priority this sprint. 2) Run Observability retention work in parallel as a medium-scope ticket. 3) Start quant spike with minimal DS/devex support and re-evaluate next planning. 4) Revisit full autoscale rollout in next planning cycle.
akash (PM): all good from PM side. any blockers?
linda (eng-manager): main blocker is coverage in oncall window if autoscale causes regressions. request: schedule a canary cutover during low traffic and ensure rollback plan.
raj (infra): we'll add an automated rollback flag and a canary runbook. deploy-bot will annotate the canary.
deploy-bot: canary run scheduled for 1765630000 (automated) — will post status updates.
zoe (devex): will add quant evaluation test cases to the devex repo so the spike has infra to iterate on.
tyler (ds): will start data pull on Monday.
olivia (solutions): I'll notify customer A of scoped MVP commitment and timeline.
maria (PM): staffing follow-up: can we temporarily borrow a contractor for 4 weeks to cover the two engs we lack? budget approved pending you-all's OK.
linda (eng-manager): contractor OK if ramping cost is acceptable. prefer someone with runtime/async experience.
akash (PM): finance ok with short contractor. please share job profile.
linda (eng-manager): I'll post a short req after this thread.
maria (PM): summary decisions in checklist form: 
- [x] Autoscaling (scoped MVP) prioritized this sprint, staffing assigned (2 eng + 1 infra)
- [x] Observability retention prioritized in parallel (1 FE + 1 BE)
- [x] Quant spike started (0.2 FTE DS, 0.5 FTE devex)
- [x] Contractor allowed for ramp (linda to post req)
- [x] Canary run + rollback plan required (raj to own)

maria (PM): thanks all — I'll convert this to PRD/roadmap ticket and link it.
akash (PM): thank you. moving to backlog board.
zoe (devex): :thumbsup:
olivia (solutions): :party_parrot: excited to show customer A the MVP.
raj (infra): noting cross-team dependency: eng-runtime & infra must sync on API changes by EOD Fri.
linda (eng-manager): noted. I'll book the sync.
maria (PM): closing thread — follow-ups in the PRD comments.
